title: MLE-bench: Evaluating Machine Learning Agents on Machine Learning Engineering
summary: We introduce MLE-bench, a benchmark for measuring how well AI agents perform at machine learning engineering.
body: We introduce MLE-bench, a benchmark for measuring how well AI agents perform at machine learning engineering.
summaryZh: OpenAI 正式发布 MLE-bench，这是一个专门用于评估 AI 智能体执行机器学习工程任务能力的基准测试。该基准通过模拟真实世界的机器学习竞赛、模型训练与调优等工作流，用以衡量大模型智能体在工程实践中的实际自动化水平，对代理技术的评估与发展具有重要导向作用。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI 推出了评估 AI 智能体在机器学习工程任务上表现的全新基准 MLE-bench。
